name: Agent Activity
description: Codex-style agent progress panel with task checklist, status badges, progress bar, and timestamped tool call log.

props.name: tasks
props.description: Required. Checklist entries with id, label, status (pending, running, completed, error) and optional detail. Example: tasks={[{ id: "1", label: "Read files", status: "completed" }]}

props.name: agentName
props.description: Name shown in the panel header. Example: agentName="Codex"

props.name: status
props.description: Agent state rendered as a status badge and used for the header colour. Example: status="working"

props.name: toolEvents
props.description: Timestamped tool call log rendered under the checklist. Example: toolEvents={[{ id: "t1", name: "read_file", summary: "src/index.ts" }]}

props.name: elapsedLabel
props.description: Elapsed time text shown on the right of the header. Example: elapsedLabel="1m 12s"

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class names for the panel. Example: className="max-w-lg"
